findings.observed: Specific creature/item and exact reward/reference effort are drawn before selection and included in offers passed to choice policy.
findings.required: WB-D135/136/149: choose visible rank card before drawing/revealing exact creature/item.
findings.impact: Shortest and highest-FP strategies exploit hidden future target data. Highest-rank tie-break can also use hidden exact reward. Published A87 choice/acceptance/readiness/FP summaries cannot establish compliant player outcomes.
findings.disposition: Preserve historical results; mark superseded for compliant choice interpretation; make a separately versioned corrected study.

unchanged_findings: FP accounting checks remain scoped evidence of their actual historical model
Ownership and readiness are distinct by approved contract independently of simulation
Geometric dry tails are not a gameplay cap
Numeric prices, q, ordinary income and access profiles remain hypotheses

follow_on.deliverable: Separate visible-rank model; public-information-only selection, target draw after selected card, seeded replay/noninterference checks and bounded sensitivity results
follow_on.gate: Do not retune or adopt prices from old hidden-information result
